title: Outlook repeatedly requests password
description: A finance user cannot access email. Outlook prompts for a password every few minutes after a laptop update.

recommendation.summary: Authentication symptoms match the Microsoft 365 sign-in runbook.
steps: Confirm the affected user and scope; do not request passwords.
Verify the user can reach the approved sign-in page.
Ask the identity administrator to check account lock and sign-in logs.
recommendation.proposedAction: Approve a guided user sign-in and identity-admin review. No account or infrastructure changes will be performed.

timeline.message: Recommendation is waiting for human approval.
